title: Unified-task JEPA representation geometry
projection: Fixed observations; final-frame StandardScaler and PCA-50; independently PCA-initialized, Procrustes-aligned t-SNE; robust per-frame display normalization

variants.label: Complete collapse
variants.description: The representation contracts into a low-rank state with little usable task geometry.

variants.label: Partial collapse
variants.description: Some task structure survives, but the representation remains compressed and unevenly organized.

variants.label: Well-formed geometry
variants.description: A high-rank representation preserves distinct, usable geometry across all four control domains.
